title: Cancellation and Return Terms Recorded against Each Hotel Rate Plan
content:
This schedule records, plan by plan, the cancellation terms of the Hotel Rate Plans: the free-cancellation term, the two ways a penalty may be expressed, the ladder of shares by distance from arrival, the form value is returned in and how long settlement takes.

## Free-cancellation term, penalty measures and settlement

| Rate plan | Free-cancellation term, hours | Cancellation penalty, room nights | Flat cancellation share, percent | Form value is returned in | Settlement time, business days |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Non-Refundable Saver Rate | 0 | 0 | 100 | nothing is returned | 0 |
| Advance Purchase 21 Rate | 0 | 1 | 50 | the original form of payment | 14 |
| Semi-Flexible Rate | 72 | 1 | 25 | the original form of payment | 10 |
| Standard Flexible Rate | 24 | 1 | 10 | the original form of payment | 7 |
| Member Flex Rate | 24 | 1 | 10 | the original form of payment | 7 |
| Suite Flexible Rate | 48 | 2 | 20 | the original form of payment | 7 |
| All-Inclusive Flex Rate | 168 | 3 | 35 | credit at the property | 10 |

## Cancellation ladder: the share of the room total withheld by how far ahead of arrival the cancellation falls

| Rate plan | 30 or more days | 29 to 8 days | 7 to 2 days | 1 day or fewer |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Non-Refundable Saver Rate | 100 | 100 | 100 | 100 |
| Advance Purchase 21 Rate | 0 | 25 | 50 | 100 |
| Semi-Flexible Rate | 0 | 0 | 25 | 50 |
| Standard Flexible Rate | 0 | 0 | 0 | 10 |
| Member Flex Rate | 0 | 0 | 0 | 10 |
| Suite Flexible Rate | 0 | 10 | 20 | 35 |
| All-Inclusive Flex Rate | 0 | 10 | 20 | 35 |

Every ladder figure is a percentage of the room total.

## Notes on the columns

The **free-cancellation term** is the number of hours before arrival by which a cancellation carries no penalty; the Non-Refundable Saver Rate and the Advance Purchase 21 Rate record 0. The **penalty in room nights** and the **flat share** are the two forms a penalty may take; the room nights are taken at the booked rate. The **settlement time** is the number of business days the settlement of an approved return takes, and the Non-Refundable Saver Rate records 0 because it returns nothing.
